facts.scope_guard: Potential permit need is not an issued permit, planning permission or candidate viability result.
Landfill or permit context does not prove current contamination, title, planning status or remediation completion.

scope_guards: Potential contamination is not a legal Part 2A contaminated-land determination.
Planning suitability, Building Regulations and environmental permits remain distinct regimes.
Historic landfill context is not measured current contamination or remediation status.
Permit-screening triggers do not prove that a permit is required, issued or complied with.
Generic technical guidance is not a completed conceptual site model or investigation.
Environmental records are not HMLR title, owner or candidate geometry.
No remediation cost, residual liability or viability score is inferred without site-specific evidence.
No score or promotion is written without exact history, investigation, risk assessment, planning and permit evidence.
